notes.title: Update Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've released a small patch that addresses the following:

[list]
[*] Fixed the bug regarding the controls to adjust text bubble duration or turn them off entirely.
[*] Humans and posters now change color when clicked for the first time.
[*] Fixed various minor bugs to enhance gameplay stability.
[*] We did some optimizations for smoother performance.
[/list]

Thank you,
Gemcraft Games Team
